_comment: Dated, falsifiable, no-stakes predictions. A threshold of {"from_metric": k} means 'the value of metric k in the as-of snapshot' and is filled in by compute.py. The same list is registered in the nearbooks contract (contract/scripts/register_predictions.py).

predictions.claim: Total NEAR supply on the first snapshot on/after 2026-12-31 is higher than at the as-of snapshot (no net burn at the protocol level).
The buyback wallet still holds at least as much NEAR as at the as-of snapshot (revenue is accumulated, not spent or burned from it).
Net issuance over the trailing 28 days is still positive on the first snapshot on/after 2027-01-31.
The daily volume needed for NEAR to be net-deflationary stays above 2x the trailing 30-day average volume on the first snapshot on/after 2027-01-31.
